name: B&B Triplewall Containers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, B&B Triplewall Containers Ltd manufactures corrugated boxes and boards[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
BBTCL was the first company in India to put up an automated plant with a BHS corrugator and BOBST FFG. It manufactures paper container packaging products viz. corrugated boxes, boards, sheets, etc. used for packaging needs of various industries

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Promoter holding has increased by 1.70% over last quarter.
cons: Stock is trading at 3.60 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.01% over last 3 years.
